title: Low Carb Beef Stroganoff (ground beef stroganoff)
conventions: buy strings are cook measures (what goes in the pot), grams derived FROM the printed measure via db\densities.json (or the flagged label/USDA unit weights where densities has no row) so the two agree by construction; quantities quantized to house quarters, drift from the exact 3.5x scale noted per line where it exceeds 5%.
ruled_substitutions: Serve-over base: the source's own section heading makes cabbage noodles and cauliflower rice EITHER/OR alternatives (extractor concern says do not sum both). House books CABBAGE as the primary (cheapest, 6 of 7 stores, existing map entry); cauliflower rice is recorded as the source's alternative, unpriced and excluded from macros to avoid double-counting.

macro_cross_check.verdict: PASS - protein +8.3%, calories within half a percent of the source's 466. Carbs 11.1 vs their 5.86 because theirs is a NET figure excluding the serve-over base (their own parenthetical says 8.3 g net WITH the cabbage); our 11.1 is gross carbs including the cabbage and stays ~24 g under the ceiling. Source's stated 21 mg sodium is plainly wrong for a dish with beef base and Worcestershire (extractor concern) but sodium is not a gated field.
